newsitem.title: USA: EXXON SAYS BAYTOWN CAT CRACKER DOWN.
newsitem.headline: EXXON SAYS BAYTOWN CAT CRACKER DOWN.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Wednesday that its Bayton Number 3 catalytic cracker unit, with a rated capacity of 110,000 barrels per day (bpd), was taken down due to operational problems.

In a statement, the company said the "unit was taken out of service at approximately 8 p.m. Tuesday evening due to operational problems...The company cannot speculate when the unit will return to service."

Earlier on Wednesday, an Exxon source said the cat cracker had not been fully brought down while tests were being run. The source said he expected a short downtime of a day or so, though it was not possible to determine until the problem was evaluated.
Exxon's Baytown plant, with a crude distillation capacity of around 411,000 bpd, has total cat cracking capability of around 190,000 bpd, the official statement said.
